notes.title: Update Notes for June 2nd
notes.content:
Introducing new races to the game environment. Humans which have Wizardry barrack troops 20% stronger and 5% harvest more resources. Elves which have Archery barrack troops 20% stronger and Resource buildings 15% cheaper to build and upgrade. Dwarves which have Knight barrack troops 20% stronger, Military buildings, troop levelup, building upgrades 10% cheaper. All troops 5% cheaper to recruit.

notes.title: Update Notes for January 21st
notes.content:
This week I have been working hard on reworking the whole building concept and player teleporting functionality! Now when building the objects you will have possibility to move the camera around your fortress to easily find the best location for your object to place. Also, from now on every single player can teleport to other player fortresses for free to spectate their fortress. That means decorating your fortress is a huge prestige and power showoff symbol, every established player will be spectated by newbies to find out the best building patterns or ideas how to attack your fortress the most strategically!
[img]https://manakeep.us-east-1.linodeobjects.com/devlog/images/2024/1/21/Re4uxR1PN9SVvnoN/Capture.png[/img]

This will let you to prepare psychologically for the stronger and important raid moment or simply decline the raid and continue the farming as usual!

notes.title: Update Notes for January 2nd
notes.content:
Happy new year everyone and this new year there we have great updates!
[list]
[*] Implemented novice apple farm quest, novice cereal farm quest and novice fish farm quest.
[*] Implement new booster for each building which is about main building quest.
[*] Implemented blinking quest popup to be better visible and repopup on levelup if any quest completed.

notes.title: Patch Notes for December 30th
notes.content: New day - new update! And it is about guilds! Without much considerations we can all agree that guild fortresses reward acquisition were unfair and solo oriented. Undoubtfully the date for refactor have came and this is how the new formula will work. First of all, the guild resource buildings gives 5 times less resources in-general than your home buildings. Secondly, the guild resource building skill now depends on all online players which are in-guild based on the formula provided which should engage guild members to be active in the specific time all together to loot the resources when everyone are active. Lastly, and the most importantly everyone can take the guild resources loot based on their own harvesting offline time. Besides of that, introduced new button teleport to guild fortress from guild management UI and implemented few bug-fixes as always.

notes.title: Patch Notes For December 29th
notes.content: Great server patch have came today! The fortress list have been greatly improved and from now on you will see all players fortress without any limits in distance. You won't see guild members in the fortress list, also the cost of teleportation to other fortress have greatly increased in price and the formula is based on your character strength. The goal of this change is that old players won't profit easily on newcomers to loot only extra few hundreds of resources. Also, the important changes have been applied to the guild management beta UI. Yeah, it is still in beta due its poor designs however its functionality have expanded greatly. Now you can kick the player from guild and also you can teleport to guild member fortress for free in case if you want to meetup together! Lastly, fixed some trivial bugs in quests and etc.

notes.title: Update for November 13th
notes.content: Introducing new quests icon in game interface available after your first login to remind you whether there are quests which you can claim reward!

notes.title: Update for November 12th
notes.content: Today is coming huge rework in quests user interface and the in-game quests itself. Hundreds of new daily, main and side quests were implemented to better drive newcomers in their correct direction of what to do next in their own fortress and help to achieve their goals with a piece of extra resources on their milestones. The new update is oriented for the newcomers and in some cases might not work well good for existing old users. For example, if you have built a building in its max level then you cannot complete the quest and in case you would like to you will need to destroy the building. Also, in some cases if you completed few quests before you might be newly rewarded from this quests list again. I don't consider this a bug and its planned to work like that to not make extra hard changes on backwards compatibility with the old quest log. The difference between new and old is huge right? Tell me how better is the new quests list and what quests you will like to see further?

notes.title: Update Notes for November 5th
notes.content: Introduced brazil proxy for better latencies. If you are South American player try it out and let me know in discord if it works any better for you. Also introduced in options to check your ping and fps while playing!

notes.title: Patch Notes For November 1st
notes.content: Several UI fixes and huge refactoring's in might system. Also, from now on the might bonus is displayed in the UI everywhere you upgrade or recruit something.

notes.title: Patch Notes For September 31st
notes.content: Today we are having MEGA update! First of all, huge changes in the military barracks. Now every single troop will have its max recruit amount per type which means you will have to strategy more and not focus only on a single troop to max. From now on first 25 raids will give you double rewards and you will have possibility to restart them later for gems. Added premium resource booster and premium exp booster in shop to purchase with gems. Fixed lots of minor bugs in the game.

notes.title: Patch For September 7th
notes.content: Today we have HUGE update! First of all, introduced 5 more raids for raids level 50 - 70 including new raid boss the el champion. Introduced new tier 3 troop the noble swordsman. Fixed druid damage formulas, a little bit nerfed the sir wolf so now he is easier to complete. Also, major change that now raids have daily raid limit which is 300 and it resets every day. Assuming one raid takes one minute to play there should be available 5 hours of active game play (and single reset possibility for power gamers for 25 gems). This change was introduced in order to prevent 24/7 macro raids and for that reason I have noticed several players have been used macros. Undoubtfully within this critical change, I have applied penalties for everyone who I have identified to be using macros. The use of any cheating is not allowed and in further cases may lead to a permanent deletion of account. Lastly, spoiler alert- this week I will be working on open world creature camps and an amazing RPG story lines related within the open world creature camps. I hope to deliver those changes soon!

notes.title: Update Notes for October 3rd
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Introducing new highscores category the Might. The might is an calculated unit of your overall fortress strength. Including your player level, your player skill levels, spell upgrades, number of buildings, the upgraded levels of buildings, the troops you currently have and their level. Basically anything you can achieve, even being in the guild gives you might because it means your character is stronger.
[*] Also fixed many trivial bugfixes.
[/list]
